test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which state had more than one-third of the total sugar production in India in 2019-2020?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Uttar Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is the state which reports a maximum or more than** one-third of sugarcane production.**
 
• Uttar Pradesh is **India's largest sugarcane-producing state**, producing above **177 million tonnes in 2021.**
 
• Some other states as well produce sugarcane in large quantities.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**, the chief producer of sugarcane in India, is known as the** 'Sugar Bowl' of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Haryana** is mainly an agricultural economy with the prevalence of **wheat, rice, bajra, mustard, sugarcane, and cotton**. 
 
• **Punjab **state continues to be one of the largest producers of **food grains and cash crops** in the country.​
 
• Bihar is the largest producer of **Litchi, Makhana, Guava, and Lady's finger** in India.
